summary: HR Assistant with extensive experience in employee onboarding, background checks, HR record maintenance, and quality assurance. Skilled in organizational tasks, problem solving, active listening, and maintaining confidentiality while supporting management, employees, and vendors.

Maintained HR records and systems

Developed reports for HR Director on clinical staff quotas
Screened phone calls, emails, letters, and personal visits
Performed quality assurance tracking/monitoring quarterly
